title: Savoy Church Burned — Before and After Photos
text:
SAVOY CHURCH BURNED—A before and after the fire pictures of the Savoy Church of Christ are shown in the top pictures. The bell, at bottom, was located in the tower and came crashing through the floor at the height of the blaze. Mayor S. A. Bibby of Savoy is shown at right. He called the mass meeting after the fire that should get Savoy a fire fighting force.
(Staff Photos)
notes: Caption text only for a multi-photo spread. Top photos show before and after of the Savoy Church of Christ. Bottom photo shows the church bell which fell through the floor during the fire. Right photo shows Mayor S. A. Bibby. The article relates to the same 1954 fire series as the other 1954fire clippings. The mass meeting called by Mayor Bibby was intended to establish a volunteer fire fighting force for Savoy.
